description: Render self-contained HTML (inline CSS, data: images, no scripts or external resources, up to 1 MiB) into an A4 PDF (up to 20 pages / 10 MiB) and return its public URL. Costs 0.020 USDC per call via x402 from the account wallet. The URL is public and non-guessable, eligible for deletion after 7 days, and not renewable: do not render confidential content. If the response is render_effect_pending, the payment was kept and the error carries paidCallId: do not pay again.

filename.description: Optional filename used for a readable public URL slug, for example invoice-2026-09.pdf. Consecutive dots (..) anywhere are invalid.

html.description: Self-contained HTML document (UTF-8, up to 1 MiB) with inline CSS. No JavaScript, iframes, forms, <link>, external or relative resources: scripting is disabled and document requests are intercepted/aborted in an offline browser context, not process-wide OS egress isolation. The Chromium sandbox is disabled; process isolation is a deployment concern. Embed images and fonts as data: URIs (png, jpeg, gif, webp, svg, woff/woff2/ttf/otf). Output is A4, up to 20 pages / 10 MiB on successful return, with a 10-second application-level render watchdog budget. Launch, shutdown and cleanup can extend elapsed call time; this is not a hard process-lifetime bound. Page and PDF-byte limits are checked after PDF allocation and do not bound peak memory or CPU.

name: render_pdf
